meaning.en: Of or pertaining to an estimate or to estimation.

sentences.vi: Đây là một con số ước tính.

sentences.en: The results of estimation showed that the more vary of additives rate used, the more diverse between actual discharge of hazardous waste and estimative one.

sentences.en: To classify all the possible factors of the investing risks and establish an estimative system for financial risks.

sentences.en: At the same time, as a result of limitations of investigation and basic financial data of the project is estimative and forecast able, financial evaluation has unavoidable limitation.

sentences.en: The experimental results show that the above-mentioned method can be used not only as estimative analysis but also as quantitative analysis of mechanism balance.
